Job Title
Account Executive (Client-Facing | Closing Experience Required)

Location

Remote

Time Zone

US Time Zones (EST–PST)

Role Overview
Our client is seeking a highly polished, confident Account Executive with proven closing experience to serve as a primary, front-facing representative of their brand. This is a high-visibility, video-forward role for professionals who are comfortable on camera, take pride in their professional presentation, and understand the importance of first impressions in client relationships. The Account Executive will manage the full sales cycle while consistently representing the brand with confidence, credibility, and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle from qualified lead through close

  • Conduct virtual salescalls, presentations, and demos with prospective clients

  • Represent the client’s brand in all external-facing interactions with a polished, professional presence

  • Build trust and rapport through confident, articulate, and engaging communication

  • Maintain a strong on-camera presence during video-based client meetings

  • Consistently meet or exceed revenue and closing targets

  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting in CRM systems

  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless and premium client experience

  • Follow structured sales processes while adapting to client needs and expectations

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an Account Executive or closer with a strong record of closed deals

  • Demonstrated prior remote work experience; candidates must be fluent with remote collaboration tools (e.g., Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana or similar) and have experience working with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered.

  • Exceptional verbal communication skills with a confident, professional on-camera presence

  • Comfortable leading high-stakes, client-facing sales conversations via video

  • Strong attention to personal presentation, professional image, and brand representation

  • Ability to represent a company with polish, credibility, and confidence in every interaction

  • Self-motivated, reliable, and able to perform independently in a remote environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in consultative, high-ticket, or service-based sales

  • Background in industries where image, professionalism, and first impressions are critical

  • Experience in presentation-heavy, externally facing, or brand ambassador-style roles

  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDICC, etc.)

Tools & Technology

  • CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)

  • Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams

  • Slack and Google Workspace

  • Proposal and e-signature tools (PandaDoc, DocuSign, or similar)

  • Scheduling and salesenablement tools (Calendly, Outreach, etc.)

Interview Process – Important
This is a highly client-facing role, and the interview process includes a mandatory video submission. Candidates must:

  • Treat the video as a formal business interview

  • Dress in professional business attire (equivalent to a suit-and-tie interview standard)

  • Present themselves exactly as they would for a high-level client or executive meeting

This role is ideal for professionals who enjoy presenting themselves in a refined, professional manner, are confident on camera, and are excited to serve as the visible face of a brand in client interactions.

We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities.

About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// As part of the Passenger Apps team, you'll lead the delivery and ongoing development of Masabi's native passenger applications, the white-label Justride/Passenger experience deployed across transit agencies worldwide, spanning iOS, Android and Web.

This is a hands-on Technical Lead role with a balance of approximately 50% technical contribution and 50% people leadership, delivery management and team coordination of 4-6 developers. Alongside supporting a team of engineers, you'll remain actively involved in technical design, implementation, code reviews and delivery planning, focused on integrating Masabi's Justride SDK and public API platform capabilities.

Location_

// This role is available in a remote model for candidates based in Poland

Type of Role_

// This role is available as an up to 12 months Fixed Term Contract

Responsibilities_

Technical Leadership & Delivery

  • Own delivery across the Passenger iOS, Android and Web applications, clearing blockers and keeping releases predictable

  • Remain actively involved in technical implementation, design discussions and code reviews, setting the bar for engineering quality

  • Drive the integration of Masabi's Justride SDK and public APIs into Passenger applications

  • Lead application migrations, release management, rollout planning and deployment activities

  • Support engineering practices that enable effective delivery across the team

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and support a team of engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, performance feedback and clear development conversations

  • Create an environment where engineers can grow, develop and do their best work

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering stakeholders to align priorities, delivery plans and team goals

  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team culture

  • Contribute to hiring, onboarding and team growth activities as needed

  • Provide visibility on delivery progress, risks and dependencies to stakeholders

About You_

  • Strong hands-on engineer at heart, current in at least one native platform (Swift/UIKit or Kotlin/Coroutines) and able to move confidently across both

  • You’ve led technical delivery across engineering teams, owning quality through code review and design guidance rather than stepping back from the work

  • You've managed and grown engineers directly, running 1:1s, coaching and honest feedback

  • Comfortable in multi-tenant or white-label products, where one codebase serves many customers with different needs

  • Experience delivering and evolving production applications, including migrations or modernisation efforts

  • Knowledgeable and experienced in SDK and API integrations

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools and able to demonstrate how you’ve incorporated them into engineering workflow

  • A calm communicator who keeps stakeholders aligned and can hold the balance between coding and leading

Nice to Have_

  • Familiarity with release management, rollout strategies and deployment processes

  • Knowledge of CI/CD tooling and engineering quality practices

  • Participation in hiring, onboarding or team growth initiatives

  • Prior experience in Fintech or Transit domains

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

About the Role

We're looking for a Media Relations Associate who can help shape how A1 is introduced to the world.

You will develop our external narrative, work closely with founders and leadership, build relationships with global media, and ensure every public communication reflects the quality and ambition of the company.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be writing, editing, pitching stories, preparing announcements and working directly with senior leaders on communications strategy.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build relationships with technology, business and mainstream media.

  • Develop communication plans around product launches, partnerships and major company milestones.

  • Work closely with product, recruiting and leadership teams to ensure consistent external messaging.

What You Will Need

  • Experience in PR, corporate communications or media relations within technology companies.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with the ability to explain complex products clearly.

  • Strong relationships with technology and business journalists.

  • Experience managing communications for product launches or major announcements.

  • Excellent judgement and ability to develop compelling narratives.

  • Comfortable working directly with founders and senior leadership.

  • Able to operate independently in a fast-moving environment with minimal direction.

  • Strong attention to detail and high standards for quality.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams. We operate with high talent density, fast execution speed, and strong ownership. We care deeply about product quality, clear thinking, and practical execution.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly, operate independently, and make good decisions under ambiguity. Our goal is to build products that are genuinely useful to billions of people globally.

Part-Time Construction Estimating Career Coach

(Flexible, Paid Workshops + Upside)

About CourseCareers

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without a college degree or prior experience.

We partner with industry professionals to create job-focused courses that teach practical, employer-aligned skills across technology, business, construction, and the trades. Our students are career changers looking for realistic, entry-level roles — and coaching helps bridge the gap between coursework and landing the job.

About the Role

We’re looking for a part-time Construction Estimating Career Coach to support students through live workshops and optional 1:1 coaching.

This is not a traditional employment role and not a guaranteed-income position. It’s a flexible, paid opportunity best suited for construction estimating professionals who enjoy mentoring, teaching, and helping others break into the field — with upside if students choose to work with you.

How This Role Actually Works

  • You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

  • You are paid $50 per workshop, plus any private coaching business you acquire

  • You may receive exclusive coaching opportunities based on performance and engagement

  • Workshops are used to provide value, answer questions, and showcase your expertise

  • If students choose to book you for 1:1 coaching, you keep the coaching revenue

  • You set your own availability and working hours

There is no requirement to convert students — workshops are paid regardless — but conversion is where the upside comes from.

Responsibilities

  • Host a live, one-hour workshop on a monthly basis

  • Answer student questions related to construction estimating and the job search

  • Share real-world insight into what entry-level estimating roles actually look like

  • Explain how estimating works in real construction environments (GCs, subs, specialty trades)

  • Discuss common tools, workflows, and expectations

  • Provide optional 1:1 coaching to students who request it

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional construction estimating experience

  • Experience estimating for GCs, subcontractors, or specialty trades (e.g. concrete, electrical, mechanical, roofing, etc.)

  • Familiarity with estimating tools such as Excel, PlanSwift, Bluebeam, ProEst, or similar software

  • Strong understanding of entry-level roles like Estimating Assistant, Junior Estimator, or Project Coordinator

  • Interest in mentoring and helping career changers

  • Strong communication and teaching ability

  • Availability at least three evenings per week, ideally Tuesday–Thursday

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable leading workshops independently

Ideal Fit

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Enjoy teaching and mentoring

  • Want flexible, side income

  • Like the idea of being paid to teach — with optional upside

  • Don’t need guaranteed hours or full-time income

Compensation

  • $50 per one-hour workshop (One per month guaranteed)

  • Unlimited upside from 1:1 coaching sessions you convert

  • No caps, no quotas, no minimums

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain— experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Hong Kong. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Hong Kong.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
About Us

Curvion is a high performance RevOps & sales augmentation agency that installs and deploys enterprise-grade, AI-driven revenue engines and selling systems for our clients. Think of a lead generation based marketing agency…. But focused on sales! We design and install complete sales systems from sales processes and GTM strategy to CRM setup all the way to fully outsourced sales engagements. Then we enhance those systems with AI enabled tools and battle tested playbooks, and finally, we provide highly trained sales talent to help our clients execute so their revenue engine runs faster, scales efficiently, and performs consistently. In short, we build and power modern, AI-driven sales systems that help companies grow with clarity and control.

Position Overview: RevOps Solutions Specialist

The RevOps Solutions Specialist sits at the intersection of sales, RevOps, HubSpot, and solution design.

You’ll work directly in the sales process to understand prospective clients' current sales operations, identify gaps and opportunities, and translate those findings into a clear RevOps solution.

You need to know HubSpot extremely well, but this role is much bigger than HubSpot.

You’ll help determine what systems, workflows, automations, integrations, processes, and operational infrastructure a client actually needs. From there, you’ll help scope the project, define deliverables, build the SOW, and develop pricing.

In other words, you’re the person who helps turn:

"Here's our sales problem."

into:

"Here's what Curvion should build, here's how we'll build it, and here's what it will cost."

You’ll work closely with the sales and delivery teams throughout the deal cycle, helping ensure that what we sell is technically sound, properly scoped, commercially viable, and deliverable.

This is an agency role. You’ll work across multiple prospective and active client environments, each with different sales processes, systems, and business requirements. Experience working in a client-services environment is critical.

Ideal background: HubSpot Solutions Partner, HubSpot agency, RevOps agency, CRM consultancy, or similar technology/implementation agency.

You SHOULD apply to this role if:

  • You have agency, consultancy, or client-services experience

  • You’ve preferably worked for a HubSpot Solutions Partner, HubSpot agency, RevOps agency, CRM consultancy, or similar organization

  • You’ve worked with multiple clients and HubSpot environments

  • You know HubSpot extremely well and have built real-world systems

  • You understand how sales teams actually operate, not just how CRMs work

  • You’ve participated in discovery, solution design, scoping, or technical sales conversations

  • You can look at a client's sales operation and quickly identify gaps and opportunities

  • You can translate a business problem into a technical and operational solution

  • You have experience creating SOWs, proposals, scopes, implementation plans, or project estimates

  • You understand how to evaluate project complexity, effort, resources, and pricing

  • You’re comfortable working alongside sales throughout the deal cycle

  • You can explain technical concepts to executives and non-technical decision makers without making their eyes glaze over

  • You can balance what the client wants, what they actually need, and what Curvion can realistically deliver

  • You enjoy being the bridge between sales and delivery

You SHOULD NOT apply to this role if:

  • Your HubSpot experience has only been internal to one company

  • You have no agency, consulting, or client-services experience

  • You’ve never worked across multiple client environments

  • You know HubSpot but don't understand sales or RevOps

  • You don't enjoy discovery conversations or client interaction

  • You've never had to scope a project or define deliverables

  • You aren't comfortable thinking about project effort and pricing

  • You need someone else to tell you what solution to recommend

  • You prefer staying completely behind the scenes

  • You’re uncomfortable being accountable for what gets sold and scoped

Core Outcomes

  • Prospective client needs are translated into clear RevOps solutions

  • Sales opportunities are properly scoped before they reach implementation

  • SOWs accurately define the solution, deliverables, and expectations

  • Pricing reflects the actual complexity and requirements of the engagement

  • Proposed solutions are technically sound and operationally realistic

  • Sales and delivery remain aligned throughout the deal cycle

  • Clients understand what Curvion is recommending and why

  • New projects enter implementation with clear scope and minimal ambiguity

General Expected Duties

  • Participate in sales discovery calls to understand prospective clients' sales processes, systems, challenges, and goals

  • Audit and evaluate prospective clients' HubSpot environments and broader RevOps infrastructure

  • Identify gaps across CRM architecture, sales processes, automation, reporting, integrations, and operational workflows

  • Translate discovery findings into recommended RevOps solutions

  • Design solution architecture and implementation plans

  • Determine project scope, deliverables, dependencies, and requirements

  • Build SOWs, scopes, proposals, and other sales enablement materials

  • Partner with sales leadership to develop project pricing based on scope and complexity

  • Collaborate with delivery teams to validate technical feasibility and implementation requirements

  • Support sales conversations by answering technical and RevOps questions

  • Communicate complex technical solutions in clear, business-focused language

  • Maintain alignment between what is sold and what can actually be delivered

  • Support the handoff from closed deal to implementation

  • Continuously improve Curvion's RevOps solution frameworks, scoping methodology, and pricing models

Compensation & Logistics

Job Type: Full-time, W-2
OTE: $72,000 - $100,000 annually
Additional Compensation: Bonus opportunities
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM-6:00 PM
Location: Remote

Compensation Range: $72K - $100K

About BJAK

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to help drive BJAK's AI Neobank expansion across products, markets and teams. This is a senior execution role for someone who can align leadership, drive operating cadence, solve cross-functional problems and turn strategy into measurable progress.

raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Social Media Marketer to own how Abridge grows across social. This is a role for someone who treats social as a performance channel with a funnel behind it: someone who can build an audience from a standing start, run a real experiment cadence, and connect audience growth to outcomes further down the funnel like email capture, content consumption, event registration, pipeline influence, and recruiting.

Abridge is an AI company building in healthcare, and we have the substance to build a meaningful public presence: a product that clinicians use and love, a team of practicing physicians and AI researchers, and a CEO who is himself a practicing cardiologist. Two conversations we should be central to, the AI conversation and the healthcare conversation, are happening every day on social without us in them. What we need is someone who can close that gap deliberately, with a plan, a stack, and a number they're accountable to.

Writing matters in this role. You'll be publishing in the brand voice and in the voices of our executives and clinicians, and the work has to be native and genuinely good. But the hard requirement here is growth: we're looking for a growth operator who writes well, not a writer who also reads dashboards. You'll have editorial and creative partners for the craft, and you'll be the one deciding what to test, what to scale, what to kill, and what any of it did for the business.

This role reports into Growth and partners closely with Creative, Comms, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, Events, and Recruiting. You'll own social strategy, channel prioritization, distribution, experimentation, and measurement end to end.

What You'll Do

  • Own audience growth as a number. Set and hit targets for follower growth, reach, and engaged audience by platform, and own the framework that connects social activity to ToFu, MoFu, and BoFu outcomes. Be able to say what a month of work produced and what you'd do differently next month.

  • Build and own the measurement layer. Define the metrics that matter, instrument the tracking (UTM discipline, analytics, self-reported attribution, event and campaign tagging), and report to marketing leadership on a regular cadence. Bring insights back that change what we make.

  • Run a continuous experiment program. Maintain a live backlog of hypotheses across hooks, formats, cadence, first frames and thumbnails, posting time, cross-posting, and audience targeting. Design tests that can actually be read, and be disciplined about killing what doesn't work.

  • Decide which platforms we play on and how. Own LinkedIn and X as our primary channels, and make the call on where else we should be investing across Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, TikTok, etc. Each one has a different audience, algorithm, and reason to exist for us.

  • Build the growth stack outside the native platforms. Stand up and operate the tooling that makes growth repeatable: publishing and scheduling, audience research and enrichment, listening and monitoring, link tagging, competitive and creator tracking, reporting. Automate the parts that should be automated, with clear judgment about where third-party tooling crosses a line we don't want to cross as a healthcare company.

  • Use paid amplification where organic hits a ceiling. Partner with Growth to put budget behind what's working, run retargeting off social audiences, and understand the interplay between organic reach and paid distribution.

  • Build an employee and executive amplification program that runs as a system. Identify the right internal voices among our clinicians, researchers, executives, and subject-matter experts, and build the operating model that keeps them posting: content supply, drafting support, approval flow, tooling, and measurable reach. Success here is a program that works without you writing every post.

  • Publish at a high standard and at real volume. Write, edit, ship, and iterate across posts, threads, carousels, comments, executive content, short-form video, and emerging formats. Know when something needs polish and when speed and native execution matter more.

  • Identify the stories worth distributing. Proactively find what's worth posting across the company (product launches, customer impact, research, clinicians, events, cultural moments, the people building Abridge) and bring a strong point of view on the angle and the channel.

  • Partner with Creative to get assets made. Brief designers, writers, videographers, and agencies with clear strategic and creative context. Contribute to ideation, give useful feedback, and treat creative partners as collaborators.

  • Build community. Reply with intention, surface customer and community voices, participate where our audiences actually are, and create real-time moments around launches and flagship events.

  • Use AI as a force multiplier. Incorporate AI throughout your workflow, from audience research and ideation to drafting, editing, repurposing, analysis, and reporting. Experiment with new tools and workflows, and have a considered view on where AI makes the work better and where it doesn't.

  • Partner across marketing and the company. Work alongside Growth, Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, and Events. Bring a distribution and audience perspective into planning early, and turn company priorities into social opportunities.

What You'll Bring

  • Five to eight years in social media marketing or growth marketing, with direct hands-on ownership of social as a growth channel.

  • A demonstrated track record of growing an audience, with real numbers attached. You can walk through what the account looked like when you started, where it got to, and specifically what drove it.

  • Fluency with the funnel. You've been held accountable to metrics beyond engagement, and you can explain how you connected social activity to downstream outcomes like email signups, registrations, demo requests, or pipeline, including where the attribution was imperfect and how you worked around it.

  • Analytics and attribution chops. You're comfortable in platform analytics and in tools like GA4 or Amplitude, you're rigorous about tagging and tracking, and you can build a report that leadership actually uses.

  • Hands-on fluency across multiple platforms, including LinkedIn and X, plus real working knowledge of at least a couple of others (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, and TikTok). You understand the cultural, algorithmic, and creative differences between them and can create natively for each.

  • Experience with the tooling layer around social. You've built or automated workflows for publishing, audience research, listening, enrichment, or reporting, and you have a point of view on which tools are worth it and which create more risk than value.

  • Experience running paid social, even at modest budget, and an understanding of how paid and organic compound.

  • Strong writing and editorial judgment. You can find the hook, write an opening line that earns attention, develop an idea clearly, and edit your own work. You don't need to be the best writer on the marketing team, but you need to be good enough that nothing waits on someone else to make it publishable.

  • Experience building executive, employee, or subject-matter-expert voices. You've helped people become credible public voices and can speak specifically to what made the program work and how you kept it running.

  • An AI-native working style. You use AI every day, have considered opinions about where it strengthens the work and where it weakens it, and actively experiment with new tools and workflows.

  • Experience inside a high-growth technology or AI company, where priorities move quickly and you're often creating structure where none exists.

  • Exceptional execution. You're comfortable moving fast, making decisions with incomplete information, and shipping consistently.

  • Strong cross-functional influence. You can bring people together around a point of view and move work forward without formal authority.

  • A proactive, low-ego mindset. You're curious, generous with your expertise, and motivated by work that compounds.

Bonus Points

  • You've grown a personal presence on X, LinkedIn, YouTube, or TikTok to a meaningful following.

  • You've grown an audience in a regulated or specialized industry, where credibility is built slowly and mistakes are expensive.

  • You've built communities: Slack groups, subreddits, newsletters, events.

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or selling to clinical audiences.

Working at Abridge

This position requires a commitment to a hybrid work model, with the expectation of working from our San Francisco or NYC office a minimum of three days per week. Relocation assistance is available for candidates who are willing to move to San Francisco or NYC.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $155K - $175K

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

This Role Is Not For

Location

This role is based in Japan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Japan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

raw.description:
Remote from France or Germany · Full-time

Become Kestra’s first dedicated People hire. Help us grow from 50 to 100 people over the next 12 to 18 months, and strengthen the foundations that help a distributed team work well together.

You will own recruitment and People operations, working directly with the founders and hiring managers. This is a hands-on role with room to shape the function as we grow.

Reporting to: Emmanuel (CEO) and Ludovic (CTO), our co-founders
Working language: English

Why Kestra

Orchestrate everything, everywhere. From one control plane.

Data, infrastructure, business processes and AI agents. Build, run and govern them all, in the cloud or on your own servers. AI agents follow the same rules as everything else.

We believe orchestration is becoming a shared layer of enterprise architecture: the layer that coordinates what runs across tools, teams and environments. Kestra is building that foundation as an open-source platform, giving enterprises a common way to manage increasingly complex automation.

Founded in France, we are growing our enterprise business in Europe and the United States. In March 2026, we raised a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with Alven, ISAI and Axeleo. Teams at JPMorgan Chase, Apple, TotalEnergies, Crédit Agricole, Leroy Merlin, Bloomberg and Deutsche Telekom run Kestra in production.

The opportunity

Our next stage depends on bringing in the right people and helping them succeed. We are hiring across Sales, Engineering, Product, Marketing and Customer Operations, with substantial growth planned across functions and all the regions where we operate.

You will bring dedicated People and Talent leadership to an established organisation, working with the founders, hiring managers and the Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams that already support our People processes.

With colleagues across more than ten countries and many recent joiners, the work goes beyond hiring. People need a good start, clear expectations and connections across teams. You will help make that experience consistent as we grow.

What you will own

  • Recruitment from sourcing to signed offer. Find and engage candidates, run initial conversations, coordinate focused interview processes and keep the ATS reliable. Work with the founders and leaders across functions to prioritise roles and help hiring managers make well-supported decisions.

  • People operations across countries. Work with our Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams to coordinate contracts, payroll partners, EOR providers, benefits, time off and employee requests. Keep records and deadlines clear, and work with local providers and advisers on employment requirements.

  • Onboarding that gets people started well. Make the practical setup smooth and help managers give new joiners clear expectations, useful context and the right relationships from day one.

  • Compensation and performance processes. Develop the framework with the founders, then run the cycles: salary reviews, levels, performance reviews and equity administration, including BSPCE where applicable.

  • How we work as a distributed team. Organise all-hands and the company offsite, strengthen internal communication and build routines that help people collaborate across locations.

  • A clear view of progress. Give the founders useful information on hiring, headcount and employment costs. Use it to identify bottlenecks and decide what needs attention.

What you bring

  • Experience combining People and Talent in a growing company. You have worked through a period of significant hiring and know which processes become necessary as a team grows.

  • Recruitment experience you have built yourself. You have sourced candidates, assessed them with hiring managers and closed offers. You can explain the difficult searches, the hires that worked and what you learned from those that did not.

  • Experience recruiting across functions. You have hired technical and business profiles, understand how to adapt your approach to different roles and markets, and work with managers to assess evidence of performance beyond a convincing interview.

  • Practical knowledge of international employment. You have worked with EOR providers, payroll partners and local advisers, and know when a situation needs specialist input.

  • Strong operational judgment. You are comfortable in an ATS, HRIS and payroll platforms, handle sensitive information carefully and follow through on details.

  • The ability to build and operate. You can introduce a useful process, run it yourself and improve it without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • Fluent professional English. French or German is useful for working with local employees and providers.

Experience in developer tools or open source, a background in operations or consulting, or experience supporting US employment from Europe would be valuable.

How you will work

You will build on an established organisation, supported by the Administration, Workplace Operations and Finance teams that already carry our People processes. Your role is to bring dedicated expertise, coordinate this work and help it scale as the company grows.

We already use Kestra to automate business and administrative workflows, improving them as our needs evolve. You will continue this approach with the teams involved: simplify processes, automate repetitive work and keep human attention where it matters.

Managers remain responsible for their hiring decisions and teams. You will guide them, challenge them when necessary and agree priorities with the founders as recruitment and employee needs evolve.

What we offer

  • Compensation discussed in the first conversation, based on the scope and level of the role rather than your current salary.

  • Equity participation, through BSPCE where applicable.

  • Remote work from France or Germany, with flexibility around team commitments.

  • An annual company offsite.

  • Equipment, conference and training budgets, with time to learn.

  • Direct access to the founders and the opportunity to build a function that grows with the company.

How we hire

  1. 45 minutes with Emmanuel and Ludovic: the role, your experience and your questions.

  2. 60 minutes on your work: a hiring process you ran end to end and a complex international People situation you resolved.

  3. 45 minutes with two future colleagues: one from the commercial team and one from the technical team.

Three conversations, no take-home exercise, and a decision within two weeks of the first call.

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile.

raw.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We're looking for a Social Media Manager to own day-to-day social strategy and execution across a portfolio of client accounts. You live inside culture and platforms — you know what's working, why it's working, and how to translate that into a content calendar that builds real communities, not just posting schedules. You're equally comfortable briefing in a creative team, jumping into the comments to manage community, and sitting across from a client explaining why a strategy shift makes sense.

You'll work closely with Associate Directors and Directors of Creative Strategy to build out the social calendar, brief creative execution that feels inventive rather than templated, and manage the client relationship day to day — all while keeping the account organized and operating smoothly.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).

What You'll Do

  • Manage day-to-day creative execution for organic social programs across a portfolio of client accounts

  • Partner with the Director of Creative Strategy to build out the social media calendar and plan

  • Brief and direct Designers and Editors on inventive, culturally-relevant statics, motion, video, carousels, and Stories, giving clear, actionable feedback on hooks, pacing, and edit structure

  • Lead community management in a way that actively builds community, not just responds to it

  • Write copy for social posts, flexing tone and voice by platform and client

  • Work alongside the creator team on UGC briefs and execution

  • Translate platform and performance data (hook retention, watch time, CTR, engagement rate, saves, follower growth) into clear creative and content direction

  • Maintain quality and consistency across a high volume of social creative output, flagging risk to timelines or scope early

  • Manage the day-to-day client relationship — communication, updates, and expectations

  • Keep the account organized operationally — timelines, deliverables, and workflow

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 3+ years of experience building "worlds" on social — brands with a distinct voice and engaged community, not just a content calendar

  • Fluent in social media metrics and know how to read them into decisions

  • A deep, current understanding of culture and how it moves social — not just what's trending, but why

  • Extremely up to date on algorithm changes and platform shifts across Meta, TikTok, and Instagram

  • Strong grasp of the briefing process — you know how to brief creative that's actually inventive

  • Experience using Sprout Social or a similar social management platform

  • Already using AI tools thoughtfully in your workflow — you know where they help and where they don't

  • Experience in product, beauty, fashion, SaaS, tech, or hospitality preferred, but not required

Hard Disqualifiers

  • No experience owning social accounts

  • No experience running community management

  • Strategy-only with no execution ability

  • Not comfortable presenting work to clients

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

raw.description:
Contract | Remote, worldwide | $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location | 10-20 hrs/week

Check out this Loom video for more details:

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor
  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
  • Able to evaluate code without executing it or reviewing every line
  • Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement
  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
  • High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

  • Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

  • Duration: ongoing. Projects run from about two weeks to a few months each, and we offer new ones to evaluators who do well
  • Start: as soon as you clear the take-home and a project has an open seat
  • Process: one take-home evaluation exercise with a recorded Loom walkthrough. No interview

raw.excerpt: Who We AreImprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, , H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

As Director of Fraud Strategy, you will own Imprint's fraud prevention outcomes across new account fraud, first-party fraud, and transaction fraud. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for fraud losses, team performance, and the strategic direction of fraud controls at Imprint.

You will serve as the default fraud expert at Imprint — the internal thought partner for the fraud team and the authoritative voice on fraud strategy across the broader organization. This role blends deep technical fluency with cross-functional leadership, requiring someone who can operate at the rule level when needed and influence at the executive level consistently.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Full command of Imprint's new account and transaction fraud controls, with the ability to research individual rules and field ad hoc questions or escalations independently

  • Demonstrated ability to update fraud rules — used as a proxy for sufficient operational context

  • A clear, evidence-backed point of view on the primary blockers to delivery speed (e.g., org structure, tooling, capacity, empowerment, or budget)

  • Substantive feedback delivered on the current fraud strategy vision for the next 6–9 months

  • Established as a trusted fraud authority across the fraud team and key cross-functional partners

Responsibilities

  • Own fraud loss outcomes across new account fraud, first-party fraud, and transaction fraud, with full accountability for team performance and strategic direction

  • Lead, develop, and grow a team of three direct reports — fraud leads across new account, first-party, and transaction fraud domains

  • Serve as the internal expert and thought partner for fraud strategy, both within the fraud team and across the broader organization

  • Define and evolve Imprint's fraud controls framework, balancing speed of delivery with operational complexity

  • Partner closely with modeling, engineering, and senior leadership to align on fraud priorities and resource trade-offs

  • Champion the most valuable fraud initiatives through clear storytelling and internal advocacy

  • Navigate fast-paced, cross-functional communication with clarity and precision

  • Act as an operational backstop in high-severity fraud scenarios, with the depth to engage directly when needed

  • Surface and communicate fraud risk, strategy, and performance to executive stakeholders in a compelling, accessible way

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated track record of owning fraud loss outcomes as a non-individual contributor across a major product area — minimum 3 years in a people leadership role with direct P&L or loss accountability

  • Deep expertise in fraud prevention, with hands-on experience across multiple fraud domains (e.g., new account fraud, transaction fraud, first-party fraud)

  • Industry background in money movement — fintech, banking, payments, or similar environments where financial fraud is the core scope

  • Technically proficient: able to write or read code (SQL, SAS, Python, or equivalent), even if not actively coding in the role

  • Comfortable with how machine learning models work and how they integrate into fraud decisioning

  • Clear and compelling communicator with the ability to influence across teams and levels

  • Detail-oriented with the operational depth to serve as a backup resource in a fraud incident scenario

  • Skilled at navigating trade-offs and prioritizing high-impact strategic initiatives in a fast-moving environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with credit or debit card fraud controls

  • Experience with transactional controls frameworks

  • Background building or scaling fraud functions in high-growth or early-stage environments

  • Familiarity with cross-functional fraud tooling and rule management platforms

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity packages

  • Leading configured work computers of your choice

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

  • Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

Compensation Range: $225K - $250K

Payments Product Manager (US, Remote)

Our client, a high-growth consumer subscription company, is hiring a Payments Product Manager to own their payments platform end to end. This is not a greenfield build. You inherit a modern stack — a first-party payments microservice, a payment orchestration layer routing across processors, BNPL, automated dunning, and a self-serve analytics layer — plus a dedicated engineering scrum team. Your job is to push it forward.

Two priorities define the first six months. First, rebill recovery: a meaningful share of subscription rebills fail, and too many of those customers churn for payment reasons, not product reasons. You'll audit the dunning stack, evaluate vendors, and decide whether to optimize, switch, or layer. Second, initial auth rate: routing optimization, network tokenization, express checkout, and continuous experimentation at the checkout layer.

In a given week you'll write a spec, pull your own numbers out of the data warehouse, negotiate a vendor SLA, and present findings to the CFO. There is no payments ops team behind you. When something breaks, you drive resolution. You set the roadmap, you ship, you measure.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in payments product or payments program management, subscription or e-commerce
  • Hands-on experience with payment orchestration platforms and multi-MID routing
  • Dunning and recovery expertise: retry logic, involuntary churn metrics, vendor evaluation
  • Data self-sufficiency in modern BI tools — you don't wait on an analyst
  • Demonstrated AI-native workflow: you actually use LLM and agentic tools in your product work today. This is a minimum qualification, not a preference.
  • Comfortable owning chargebacks, fraud posture, and regulatory compliance context

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Unlimited PTO, plus company holidays
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k)
  • HSA and FSA options; Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet insurance and commuter benefits (state specific)
  • Company equipment provided

You are naturally curious and think beyond the immediate request. When a prospect says they need more leads, you ask why their current pipeline is underperforming. Location:

We have offices in New York, Los Angeles, Milwaukee, and Gurgaon. This position will be based in the United States and can work remotely.

About the role:

TMB is looking for a Director of Data Science & AI to lead the team and efforts to turn data into decisions, deliver scalable intelligence that drives personalized experiences and business outcomes, and lean into AI and Automation where it makes sense. You understand how business users think, what friction looks like in real workflows, and how to communicate technical solutions in ways that land with non-technical users.

Your primary mission is to bridge the gap between what’s technically possible and what’s practically useful. This is a hands-on leadership role: you’ll set the technical direction, but you’ll also be in the data, in the model reviews, and building alongside your team when it counts. We need someone fluent in Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Vertex AI, and broader GCP ecosystem), has strong data science capabilities and the grit to take ideas from research to production.

You are a fast learner who is comfortable in ambiguity, energized by solutioning, and motivated by seeing your work drive real adoption across the organization. You'll spend your time championing smarter ways of working and helping both technical and non-technical teammates integrate AI into their everyday work, not as a disruption, but as a natural extension of how they already operate.

Your day-day: (aka Responsibilities)
  • Own the data science roadmap for the organization from core statistical modeling and experimentation forecasting, segmentation and applied AI where it adds real business value
  • Lead, mentor, and stay hands-on with a small team of data scientists: writing code and reviewing methodology, not just roadmaps
  • Oversee the design of robust, production-grade solutions utilizing core cloud systems, vector databases, and agentic workflows
  • Champion the adoption and continuous improvement of AI development tools across technical teams
  • Scale MLOps/LLMOPs practices, ensuring data observability, governance, model safety, and ethical AI compliance
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Development, and Product teams to drive technical innovation, prioritize initiatives, ship MVPs fast and iterate based on usage data
  • Design and run rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses and guide business decisions
  • Translate statistical and technical work into business language for executive stakeholders and make the case for where data science investment should go next
  • Define success metrics for internal tools and AI initiatives, and track adoption, usage, and business impact over time
  • Document tools, workflows, and best practices to scale impact beyond individual engagements
  • Stay informed on industry trends, viral content, and emerging platforms to identify new opportunities
You have: (aka Qualifications)
  • 7+ years in data science, including leading or managing a technical team
  • Strong foundation in core data science
  • Deep, hands-on fluency in Google Cloud Platform: BigQuery, Vertex AI, and building/deploying production models in a GCP environment
  • Proficiency deploying custom Gemini Enterprise Agents via Agent Engine
  • Fluency in AI tools such as Claude, CoPilot and ChatGPT
  • Strong Python and SQL skills and experience in applied AI
  • A bias for action
About this team:

The Data Science team is a small but mighty group sitting at the center of the organization. We're a centralized team, which means we work across nearly every department: from Marketing and Creative to BI, Engineering, Product, and beyond. If there's a workflow to improve, a tool to build, or a data problem worth solving, chances are we're involved.

Our work is practical by design. We build internal tools and data products that make real work easier, not to chase trends, but because the right solution at the right moment can meaningfully change how an entire team operates. We use AI where it genuinely helps, and we're skeptical of hype for its own sake. That pragmatic instinct is part of what makes us effective.

As a team, we move fast and stay scrappy. We're not a big org with lengthy approval chains. We prototype, iterate, and ship. We collaborate constantly, both within the team and across the business, and we're at our best when we're working alongside stakeholders to understand their problems firsthand rather than solving in a vacuum.

If you're joining us, you're joining a team that values curiosity, initiative, and craft. Our team genuinely believes the most impactful data work happens when technical depth meets real business context.

Our Benefits:

We value our people and offer a collaborative and engaging culture. As a Trusted Media Brands employee, you will enjoy work/life balance, generous time off and comprehensive benefits and programs. Learn more about what life is like working at Trusted Media Brands at

Trusted Media Brands embraces inclusivity and values our diverse community. We are committed to building a team based on qualifications, merit and business need. About Us

By transitioning from a traditional B2B publisher into a modern data authority, Life Science Connect is redefining industry standards. We specialize in constructing dedicated platforms, identity frameworks, and intelligence layers engineered to speed up development for life sciences experts. Our strategic investments in decoupled modern architecture and AI-enhanced engineering workflows empower our teams to rapidly deploy scalable, premium-quality products.

The Mission
We are seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst who excels at bridging product strategy, engineering, data, and AI-augmented development.
Forget traditional requirements-gathering roles that focus heavily on meeting notes and passing off tickets. In this position, you will be deeply integrated into a high-velocity engineering organization, partnering with Product, Engineering, Data, DevOps, and UX to turn strategic concepts into precise, actionable technical architectures. As a force multiplier for the engineering team, you will decode complex business challenges into clear, implementation-ready specifications, utilize AI tools to expedite analysis, and maximize the time engineers spend writing code rather than untangling ambiguity.

Why This Role Matters

As Life Science Connect evolves into a modern data authority, our ability to move quickly without sacrificing quality depends on exceptional product definition and technical clarity. The Senior IT Business Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring engineers spend their time building innovative solutions—not deciphering requirements.
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, partnering closely with engineers, embracing AI as a productivity multiplier, and helping shape the next generation of intelligent digital products, we'd love to meet you.


What You'll Actually Do

  • Translate Strategy into Engineering Execution: Partner with Product Leadership and Engineering to transform strategic initiatives into clear technical requirements, user stories, workflows, APIs, and acceptance criteria that engineers can immediately build from.
  • Drive AI-Augmented Analysis: Use modern AI tools to rapidly produce requirements, process models, technical documentation, and data mappings while maintaining exceptional structural accuracy and logical consistency.
  • Design Intelligent Product Workflows: Analyze complex business processes and design scalable workflows that leverage identity, personalization, analytics, AI services, and customer intelligence across our product ecosystem.
  • Own Product Specifications: Produce implementation-ready documentation including PRDs, functional specifications, user stories with rigorous acceptance criteria, API contracts, process flows, and data mappings.
  • Partner Deeply with Engineering: Work directly alongside Full Stack Engineers to clarify requirements, answer implementation questions, refine technical solutions, and remove ambiguity before development begins.
  • Enable Data Intelligence: Collaborate with Data Engineering to define modern data models, ingestion patterns, warehouse requirements, reporting needs, and customer intelligence workflows while ensuring data quality throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Validate What We Build: Support testing, feature validation, and release readiness by ensuring delivered functionality aligns perfectly with business objectives and technical specifications.
  • Improve How We Work: Continuously improve documentation standards, Agile practices, AI-enabled delivery workflows, and product discovery processes to help the entire engineering organization move faster with greater confidence.


What We're Looking For

5+ Years of Business Analysis Experience

You've worked closely with engineering teams building SaaS platforms, digital products, or enterprise applications and know how to bridge business needs with technical execution.

Technical Fluency

You don't need to write production code, but you're thoroughly comfortable discussing and documenting:
  • REST APIs and JSON payload structures
  • Headless CMS architectures and decoupled front-ends
  • Identity, Authentication, and Customer Identity frameworks (CIAM)
  • Relational and modern cloud data models (Snowflake)
  • Event Tracking, telemetry, and Customer Journey Analytics
  • Cloud-based application architectures and system integrations
Experience with Next.js, React, or modern JavaScript frameworks is a strong plus.


AI-Augmented Analyst

You actively use AI to scale your daily output—not just for generating text, but as a technical sparring partner for requirements generation, gap analysis, user story refinement, edge-case discovery, and workflow optimization. You know how to engineer effective prompts, but more importantly, you possess the critical engineering mindset required to validate, audit, and correct AI outputs before they reach production teams.

Core Traits

  • Product Mindset: You naturally ask "why" before "what." You understand that every requirement should tie directly to customer value, operational efficiency, measurable business outcomes, or revenue growth.

We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION:

Performs a wide range of duties relating to the origination of residential 1st mortgage loans for branch offices and outside referrals. Meets standards and objectives defined by management for mortgage loan sales and cross-selling objectives. Focuses on selling CRA products and services, targeting low to moderate-income individuals and areas, as well as non-profit organizations. Assumes overall responsibility for the residential mortgage loan from application to closing. Responsible and accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and personally following policies and procedures as defined. Accountable for always doing the right thing for customers and colleagues and ensures that actions and behaviors drive a positive customer experience. While operating within the Bank's risk appetite, achieves results by consistently identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring, and reporting risks of all types.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Leading Internal and External Sales and Partnership meetings
  • Assist CRA MLO colleagues with General Loan Support and Business Development
  • Membership in real estate trade association and or nonprofit partners board or committee involvement
