Technical Excellence

  • Expertise: 8+ years of Technical Product Management experience (or equivalent technical role) in complex technical domains. Comfortable discussing technical design trade-offs and system quality attributes with engineering teams.

  • Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of modern analytics architectures and data developer tooling — including dbt based transformation workflows, a governed Semantic Layer, and performant query and visualization experiences (e.g., Tableau, Preset, Posit Connect); plus deep familiarity with the practitioner stack: IDEs and notebooks (Cursor, JupyterLab, VS Code), Python/SQL developer tooling, interactive compute environments, and data quality/observability frameworks.

  • Curiosity: Demonstrated passion for Analytics with a pulse on emerging trends. Actively seeks new perspectives and brings fresh thinking to technical challenges. Regularly uses products and observes customers to identify improvement opportunities.

Product Leadership

  • Strategic Vision: Proven track record of managing product portfolios in complex technical domains with clear vision and strategy to maximize portfolio impact. Skilled at connecting business objectives with user needs, balancing quick wins with strategic bets, and making thoughtful trade-offs.

  • Customer Obsession: Deeply understands user needs through continuous engagement. Exceptional at identifying and articulating clear problem statements. Develops innovative solutions with strong product intuition and taste, thinking holistically about end-to-end user experience.

  • Business Acumen: Understands how platform investments drive business outcomes. Articulates the ROI of technical investments in business terms and connects platform capabilities to Netflix's strategic priorities. Balances technical excellence with business pragmatism.

  • Data Driven: Deeply analytical mindset that leverages quantitative and qualitative data to understand user behavior, validate assumptions, and inform product decisions. Builds a metrics-driven culture with clear success metrics to measure impact and drive continuous improvement.

  • Decisive Leadership: Makes timely decisions that provide clear direction and reduce ambiguity without analysis paralysis. Shows conviction in product opinions while remaining open to new information. Removes decision bottlenecks and shields teams from unnecessary scope creep.

Collaboration & Influence

  • First Team Player: Creates psychological safety through vulnerability and assuming best intent. Values diverse perspectives and operates with a collaborative mindset where team success trumps individual accomplishments. Skilled at giving and receiving feedback with a growth mindset.

  • Stakeholder Alignment: Builds strong relationships across organizational boundaries based on mutual respect and shared goals. Navigates complex organizational dynamics to drive alignment. Adapts communication style to different audiences and contexts to maximize effectiveness.

  • Influential Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence and inspire. Great at rallying teams around a vision and motivating others to action.

Execution Excellence

  • Delivery Focus: Builds reputation through consistent, high-quality delivery. Disciplined prioritization with clear timelines and accountability. Drives initiatives to completion rather than letting them linger. Comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and adjusting course as needed.

  • Learning Mindset: Champions incremental learning and fast feedback loops with customers. Values progress over perfection and breaks down large initiatives into manageable increments that deliver value at each stage. Adapts quickly based on real-world user feedback.

raw.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house world-class ad tech ecosystem to offer our members more choices in consuming their content. Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences.

Our Team

The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business. This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution. This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers. We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them.

Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time. Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision.

Skills & experience we’re seeking:

  • Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.

  • General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape.

  • Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs.

  • Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),

  • Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.

  • Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

Nice to haves:

  • Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.

  • Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints

Spotlight on Ads Engineering Teams:

The Ad Supply teammanages the policies and technical integrations for third-party ad supply. While Netflix has traditionally licensed content, we're exploring this alternative funding model. The team solves complex challenges, such as determining how both Netflix and the third-party partner can sell ad inventory for the same content without conflict. They establish clear rules for inventory sharing, campaign setup, and system configurations to ensure consistency and fairness.

The Ads Measurement teambuilds systems that enable advertisers on Netflix to quantify campaign outcomes. Leveraging a blend of Netflix innovations and both first-party and third-party solutions, we deliver ads that respect the viewing experience while driving impactful results for advertisers. Our tools empower advertisers to effectively measure and analyze these outcomes.

The Ads Identity and Audience teamis dedicated to delivering a relevant and engaging advertising experience while prioritizing consumer privacy. Our mission is to maintain precise subscriber identities to ensure that ads are not only engaging but also respectful of consumer privacy choices and regional regulations. We maintain a high-quality Identity Graph, which is used for various purposes, including respecting privacy choices and regulations, audience onboarding, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

The Ads Creatives & Policy teamat Netflix is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that enhance the ad experience for both viewers and advertisers. We are responsible for managing the lifecycle of ad creatives, ensuring compliance with policies, and leveraging cutting-edge technology to optimize ad delivery. Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your contributions directly impact the viewing experience of millions worldwide.

The Ads Media Planning teamis at the heart of designing and delivering state-of-the-art media planning solutions that power Netflix’s advertising business. We are developing innovative, in-house ad tech systems that enable advertisers and internal partners to efficiently plan, allocate, and optimize media investments across Netflix’s platform. Our technology translates advertiser objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance, and management of media strategies at scale. We work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust media planning capabilities that serve our advertisers, members, and Netflix’s broader business goals.

The Live Ads Management teamis driving one of Netflix’s most exciting frontiers — bringing advertising to Live Events. We’re building the intelligence that powers ad experiences during some of Netflix’s biggest real-time moments, from live sports to global specials. Our team develops smart, scalable capabilities that help ad operations plan, set up, and deliver ads seamlessly during live broadcasts. We’re pushing the boundaries with automated manifest generation, machine learning–driven optimizations, and agentic workflows that adapt in real-time to maximize both monetization and viewer experience. We work hand in hand with creative, streaming, and ads engineering teams to make advertising on Netflix Live feel effortless — blending storytelling, technology, and real-time decisioning into one unforgettable experience. It’s a fast-moving, high-visibility team shaping how live entertainment and advertising come together on a global stage.

The Ads Platform Foundations teambuilds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows. Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Campaign Management teamis responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers. The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc) as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem.

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting teambuilds state-of-art real-time inventory forecasting solutions leveraging ML models and high-performance ad server simulations. The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which support various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split, and yield optimization.

The Ads Data Clean Room teamis redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising. We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. Our scope extends beyond traditional clean room use cases to include novel integrations where data has traditionally been shared more openly. As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance team’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, Invoicing and Journal processes. The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams. This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads Eventing teambuilds and operates the foundational systems that collect, validate, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at a massive scale. These high-throughput data pipelines ingest raw signals from client devices (TV, mobile), server-side ad insertions, and external third-party integrations. The core mission is to transform these raw signals into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams, ensuring data quality and fidelity across the board. This critical infrastructure directly powers all core downstream functions, including real-time ad serving decisions, robust measurement and attribution systems, and financial reconciliation and billing workflows.

The Ads Reporting Infrastructure teamis responsible for delivering the final, actionable data to stakeholders. Their focus is on building the systems that consume validated and enriched ads delivery data to power the comprehensive reporting surfaces used by internal teams and advertisers to analyze campaign performance and business outcomes. They ensure the data presented is accurate, timely, and easy to consume, enabling key functions like measurement and attribution analysis, financial reconciliation, and strategic decision-making based on business results.

The Ads CRM teamdelivers the AI-powered Go-to-Market platform, the strategic engine for Netflix Ads sales and marketing. We don't just collect customer data; we create a unified, enriched view of our customers and their ad spend across every source, managing the entire lifecycle for impeccable quality and completeness. Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads.

We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 andwe are now in the third season of ads.

Our new tier allows us to offer our members more choice in how they consume content, attract new members at a lower price point, and create a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. We are well into year four of our advertising journey with more exciting things to come!

Our Team

Our team is new yet faces the enormous ambition of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content. As one of the newest entrants in the rapidly growing Connected TV advertising space, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate from the competition and become a market leader in record time.

The Ads Platform Engineering org builds advertising systems and integrations that power ad delivery using our world-class content delivery ecosystem. We use a number of Netflix investments and innovations to power our ads, a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding and metadata, and more. We deliver ads in a manner that's thoughtful of our members' viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

The Account Foundations team owns the accounts domain for Netflix Ads, i.e the system that defines who our advertisers are, what they're eligible for, and how they transact. It sounds like table stakes, but we don't have a lot of the moving pieces in place yet. Today, account data is scattered across systems, hierarchies are incomplete, and too much of what should be automated is still done manually. Every team building on top of advertiser data, such as sales workflows, media planning, programmatic integrations, and packaging, runs into these gaps. Our job is to fix that from the ground up and make sure it doesn't become a problem again, as the business scales.

We're working across four areas:

  • Core Accounts:We're rebuilding the account data model that can actually represent how advertisers and agencies are structured in the real world, representing HoldCo hierarchies, brand relationships, and multi-tier agency structures with strong governance being enforced. This also enables the creation of externalized APIs, allowing advertisers and agencies to view and manage their accounts as we move into a world of agenctic buying.

  • Account Intelligence:We're building the enrichment layer to identify who our advertisers are, where they spend their advertising budget, how they're structured, and whether our internal data matches reality.

  • Account Cohort and Verification Automation:Cohort assignment and identity verification are both manual today and both scale linearly with advertiser growth. Handling these problems at scale in an automated manner will be one of the key drivers of our long term success.

  • Spend Attribution:We are building an automated attribution engine to accurately map programmatic spend from DSPs and map it with the corresponding advertisers, agencies, and ad accounts across supply channels.

The work is foundational, which means it's both high leverage and high stakes, as well as a truly zero-to-one space. The architectural decisions we make now will be load-bearing for every team in Netflix Ads for years. If you're drawn to problems where getting the architecture right the first time actually matters, this is the team for you.

We are looking for highly motivated engineers working in the advertising space who are excited to join us on this journey.

  • 4+ years of experience in Ads domain on demand side systems

  • Broad knowledge of ad tech and advertising landscape, programmatic advertising, and digital marketing trends.

  • Experience in building multi-tenant, API-first services, including REST/GraphQL best practices, versioning/backward-compatibility concerns, and spec-driven design patterns (OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).

  • Familiarity with API Gateway patterns around authentication, authorization, rate limiting, load shedding, and ingress control.

Nice to haves:

  • Early experience with customer-facing MCP concerns, such as defining tools contracts, security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration), and integration with other AI agents.

  • Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of its unique constraints

About The Team

The Live Ad Insertions team sits at the intersection of broadcast engineering, streaming infrastructure, and digital advertising. Our mission is to deliver a seamless, high-reliability ad insertion experience across live and linear streams, from primetime tentpole events like the NFL and live sports to 24/7 linear feeds and breaking news. We own the full stack of tools, systems, and operational infrastructure required to trigger, stitch, monitor, and verify ad breaks in real time at scale, without compromising the member experience.

Live advertising is one of the highest-stakes, highest-reward surfaces in CTV. When tens of millions of concurrent viewers are watching a single event, there are no second chances. A break happens once, in real time, and the window to act is measured in seconds. That demands more than reliable systems: it demands proactive observability tooling that can detect anomalies before they surface to members, and the ability to make real-time corrections mid-event when something does go wrong. This team operates with the precision of a broadcast NOC and the velocity of a software startup. We are responsible for the technology that turns a live signal into a monetized ad experience, at scale, millisecond by millisecond.

As an Engineering Manager, You Will

Lead a team of engineers building the real-time infrastructure, tooling, and operational systems for live ad insertion across server-side, client-side, and server-guided delivery models.

  • Own the reliability and operational excellence of ad insertion during 24/7 linear streams and high-stakes live events, including NFL games, live sports, and awards shows.

  • Define the technical roadmap for live ad insertion, including SCTE signal ingestion and validation, ad pod management, manifest stitching, slate handling, and ad decisioning integration.

  • Partner with ad operations, broadcast engineering, content delivery, and ad serving teams to ensure seamless signal-to-slot execution from ingest to client playback.

  • Drive hiring, retention, and development of a high-performing engineering team capable of operating in a demanding live environment.

  • Establish the on-call and incident response culture for live ad systems, setting SLAs and runbooks for break-glass scenarios during high-profile live events.

  • Contextualize your team's larger advertising strategy and translate business priorities into a technically sound, executable plan.

  • Serve as the technical authority in cross-functional discussions on live ad capabilities, representing the team to leadership, partners, and vendors.

Skills and Experience We Are Seeking

Technical Skills & Domain Expertise

  • Streaming Pipelines & Architecture:Deep hands-on experience with live streaming pipelines (from ingest protocols like RTMP, SRT, or TS through to CDN) and ad insertion architectures, including SSAI, CSAI, and SGAI (HLS interstitials/DASH).

  • Broadcast Standards & Splicing:Expertise in broadcast signaling (SCTE-35, SCTE-104, SCTE-224) and manifest manipulation for ad stitching, alongside familiarity with master control and linear playout systems.

  • Ad Pod Construction & Encoding:Advanced knowledge of managing live break constraints, including slate/fallback handling, break reconciliation, and encoding constraints (codec/bitrate matching, frame rate alignment) to prevent playback artifacts.

  • Ad Tech Decisioning:Strong understanding of ad servers, DSPs, and VAST 4.x/VMAP in live contexts, with a focus on managing strict decisioning latency budgets, timeout handling, tracking event firing, and mitigating the cascading effects of decision failures.

  • Operational Tooling:Proven track record of engineering for high-availability, zero-downtime live events, including building operational tooling for ad ops (e.g., real-time fill rate tracking, signal health visualization, and break monitoring workflows).

Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • 10+ years of total engineering experience with 3+ years managing software engineering teams in a live media, streaming, or ad tech context.

  • Strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers in competitive talent markets.

  • Ability to operate in a flat, fast-moving organization, balancing long-term architectural investments against immediate operational needs.

  • Effective communicator across both technical and business stakeholders, including ad sales, ad operations, broadcast engineering, and executive leadership.

  • Experience collaborating with content and distribution partners, including MVPDs, vMVPDs, and broadcast networks, on joint live ad insertion implementations.

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.

Purpose:

You will provide engineering support for the design of substation facilities for 69kV and above for Worley and its customers as an integral part of the Power Networks team.

Responsibilities:

Independently perform tasks that typically include:

  • Substation physical design including overall engineering and analysis for new switchyards and substations, additions and modifications.
  • Preparation of specifications and provide procurement support.
  • Preparation of engineering drawings including layout and general arrangements for all major equipment and structures required for high voltage switchyards or substation. Drawings include site plans, plan and elevation views, grounding, conduit, lighting, lightning protection and shielding, control building arrangements and details, AC station service, DC systems and Bills of Material.
  • Perform auxiliary electrical power system studies including load flow, short circuit, voltage drop, protection and coordination, ampacity, and battery sizing studies.
  • Perform substation grounding calculations and studies, lightning protection and insulation coordination, lighting, bus calculations, transformer and bus sizing calculations, fault calculations, and AC and DC auxiliary system sizing calculations.
  • Perform proposal preparation, proposal estimates, and provide input to scope documents and client presentations.
  • Work in a team-oriented environment with ability to work independently or as part of a group when and as required.
  • Responsible for the quality assurance of the documents to the applicable Worley and client standards.
  • Commitment to customer service and ability to work independently on more varied and complex tasks when required.
  • Supervise/coordinate other engineers of equal and lesser experience to successfully deliver a project. Provides technical direction to subordinate team members.
  • Complete tasks in accordance with project procedures, applicable codes and/or standards, on schedule and within budget.
  • Discuss technical problems and communicate effectively with other project personnel and outside customers.
  • Perform independent audits and reviews of technical work.
  • Perform the function of a team leader that can solve complex issues and act as a lead engineer responsible for the quality of the deliverables.
  • Interface with other departmental staff, project management, and with outside customers.
  • Ability to travel to job sites to perform site walkdown.
  • Responsible for the quality assurance of the documents to the applicable drawing standards and responsible for the proper document management procedures are followed.

What you will bring

Technical and Industry Experience:

  • Experience with power system modeling and analysis tools (e.g., ETAP, CYME, SKM).

  • Highly effective technical and practical engineering skills and ability to consistently deliver quality, accurate and timely work to Worley and its customers.

  • A sound knowledge of the fundamental requirements of the electrical engineering, and the basic requirements of other engineering fields.

  • A sound knowledge of applicable local and international standards and statutory and regulatory requirements.

  • Competent use of electrical engineering specific software.

  • Competent use of relevant software such as MS Office Suite.

  • Substantial technical land practical experience in electrical engineering in the same or similar industry including experience in working in multi-disciplinary projects and teams.

  • Experience working in project leadership role.

  • Experience in estimating project costs and writing proposal content.

  • Ideal candidate should have strong interpersonal and written communication skills that permit working efficiently alongside other senior substation engineers and designers in a team setting.

Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering and12 or more years of experience in substation design including supervisory experience.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) in the United States.

Moving forward together

We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

raw.excerpt: Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation.
raw.description:
Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation.

At Eaton, we believe diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds drive innovation and success. We're committed to empowering people and creating a brighter, more sustainable future.

Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is one of the company's fastest-growing and most strategic businesses, helping power the digital economy. As cloud computing, AI, and high-density compute environments continue to accelerate, data centers face increasing demands for performance, resiliency, sustainability, and speed-to-market. Leveraging a broad portfolio of power, cooling, software, services, and infrastructure solutions, Eaton helps customers deploy scalable, integrated data center architectures that meet today's needs while preparing for the future.

Position Summary

Eaton is seeking a Senior Systems Architect – IT Module to join the Data Center Architecture Team.

This senior technical leadership role will define and drive the architecture of the data center IT Module (white space), including high-density power distribution, cooling integration, rack infrastructure, modular deployment strategies, and pod-level system design. The position serves as the primary systems integrator across white space components, ensuring scalable, repeatable, and optimized designs that enable rapid deployment of compute capacity for hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, and next-generation AI data centers.

As a key member of the Data Center Architecture Team, you will help develop end-to-end reference architectures and collaborate directly with customers to shape future data center solutions.

What you’ll do:

Be knowledgeable of current trends and innovate the market.
Identify and build positive relationships with all account decision-makers and influencers who impact current or future business with Eaton.
Gain an in-depth understanding of the client development and buying process and be able to articulate it effectively.
Perform VoC by understanding and capturing clients' challenges and requirements and resolve them by co-designing to help evolving Eaton's portfolio.
Ensure an effective handover to Global Product Lines and Business Units so that they develop the right portfolio to respond to large customers’ requirements. Support the application engineers in charge of key accounts in implementing your designs for specific customers.
Maintain oversight of all advanced engineering-related engagements to ensure customer success and satisfaction, as well as Eaton's performance as a vendor.
Be highly knowledgeable about the client's business, commercial condition, structure, strategy, operations, and challenges. Articulate this knowledge in terms of opportunity, growth, and risk with respect to Eaton's business.
Be highly knowledgeable about Eaton's products, services, general business, structure, strategy, and operations. Articulate this knowledge in terms of value to the client's business.
Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting your proposed architecture within the Eaton organization.
Act as an effective advocate and communicator of the benefits of supporting Eaton within the client engineering organization.
Collaborate effectively with other sales and stakeholders at the function, country, region, and global levels. Provide and gain support so others can meet their responsibilities to the account.
Provide all internal stakeholders and functional departments with the account-specific guidance and insights required to execute their roles and add value to the client.
Build a multi-lane bridge between Eaton and the client organization. This may include GPL leaders, Engineering leaders, Product line managers, BU Engineers, BDM, Marketing, PMO, Services, Sales Operations & Order Management, Supply Chain, Leadership & Executive Management.
Work with the Segment Marketing team to create white papers and other technical material to promote our designs and value proposition.

Qualifications:

Leadership & experience: 15+ years in critical power system design and electrical distribution engineering (advanced degree strongly preferred).

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent recognized qualification
Minimum of 10 years of related experience in the data center business across core domains of whitespace, cooling, power, fiber, controls, and rack systems

Preferred Qualifications:

Masters degree in engineering or technical discipline

Skills:

Has led multiple complex programs delivering medium- and low-voltage power architectures for large data centers or similar mission-critical facilities, spanning from medium-voltage (e.g. 15–35 kV) substation design to high-current low-voltage and ~1500 V direct-current systems. Experience includes end-to-end oversight from conceptual architecture through deployment, with a record of on-time, reliable power system commissioning at multi-megawatt scale.
Technical expertise: Expert in power conversion architectures for data centers, including MV AC distribution, LV AC, and high-voltage DC networks. Mastery of protective coordination, converter and switchgear integration, busway and panelboard systems, large-scale UPS and energy storage, and DC power protection schemes. Keeps abreast of emerging 380 → 800 V DC standards and cutting-edge power electronics (e.g. new 800 VDC components) and is a recognized innovator (patents or contributions to industry standards such as OCP open DC architectures or IEC committees on data center power).
Systems & architecture skills: Thinks at system level beyond the white space – ensures the IT Module design aligns with upstream power (Block 2) and facility cooling systems (Block 4) for a cohesive data center architecture. Provides direction across multiple product and engineering teams (racks, busbars, cooling, monitoring, etc.) to develop standardized, integrated solutions. Mentors multi-disciplinary engineers and champions a shift from traditional, labor-intensive buildouts to automated, modular deployment approaches that improve speed-to-market and reliability.
Leadership & communication: Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive leadership and initiative, with experience guiding cross-functional teams or projects. Demonstrated mentoring ability and influence in a matrixed organization, helping train and direct other engineers.
Customer focus: Strong customer engagement skills – experience interacting with enterprise or hyperscale data center customers to understand requirements and deliver solutions that address their challenges. Ability to incorporate Voice of Customer feedback into technical designs and roadmaps.

Technical knowledge in data centers design and construction, specifically POD-level architecture and modular design, high-density compute environments (AI/ML workloads) and/or liquid cooling architectures
Project Management Experience: Experience with Product Design or Product Management with a working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite is required
Specialized Industry Knowledge: Ability to create customized data center physical layer solutions tailored to various data center subsegments, including (but not limited to) Hyperscale, liquid cooling, and the modular edge
DMAIC experience for process improvement and drive for excellence
Experience delivering POD-level architecture and modular design
High-density compute environments (AI/ML workloads) and cross-domain system integration (cooling, power, structural)
Proven ability to author whitepapers and thought leadership and lead system-level design trade-off discussions
To perform effectively, the individual shall maintain sufficient market and competitor intelligence, understand client and market primary trends and requirements and how competition addresses them and how Eaton uniquely and preferentially meets them
Highly proficient at consultative selling and at communicating Eaton's differentiated value at company, product, and service levels. Additionally, function in a research and development function
Strong customer-facing technical engagement experience

What will make you successful:

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience leading large-scale, mission-critical power architectures from concept through deployment.
  • Technical;
    • Medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution
    • UPS systems
    • Energy storage
    • Power electronics
    • AC and DC power architectures
    • Protective coordination
    • Switchgear and busway systems
  • Knowledge of emerging high-voltage DC architectures and future power distribution technologies.

Leadership & Influence

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to executive, engineering, and operational audiences.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in matrixed organizations.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction.

Customer-Focused Innovation

  • Strong customer-facing experience working with enterprise or hyperscale data center operators.
  • Ability to incorporate customer requirements into product roadmaps and solution architectures.
  • Proven ability to develop white papers, technical publications, and thought leadership content.

Continuous Improvement

  • Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, or DMAIC methodologies.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and traditional project management methodologies.

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

raw.description:
Über uns:
Eaton ist ein führendes Unternehmen im Energiemanagement, das Versorgungsunternehmen und erneuerbare Energien mit zuverlässigen, effizienten Mittelspannungslösungen unterstützt. Wir fördern Elektrifizierung und Digitalisierung, um eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft zu ermöglichen und unsere Kunden beim sicheren und effizienten Energiemanagement zu begleiten.

Für unser Power Distribution Team in Deutschland suchen wir einenKey Account Manager (m/w/d) Utilities, Germany mit folgenden Aufgaben:

Ziel der Position:
Der Key Account Manager hat das Ziel, ein nachhaltiges Umsatzwachstum für das Mittelspannungs-Schaltanlagen-Portfolio (MV Assemblies) im Einklang mit Eatons Zielen in der EMEA-Region zu erzielen und eine starke Marktpräsenz in den Bereichen Utilities und erneuerbare Energien aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Erreichen des Umsatzwachstums gemäß Profitplan für MV-Schaltanlagen im zugewiesenen Gebiet
  • Identifikation, Ansprache und Entwicklung von Angeboten bei strategischen Zielkunden sowie Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu relevanten Entscheidungsträgern
  • Verantwortung für die Entwicklung großer Projekte in Zielsegmenten für MV-Produkte in Deutschland
  • Aufbau einer Projektpipeline sowie Abschluss von Aufträgen entsprechend der Wachstumsziele
  • Erstellung und Reporting von Pipeline-, Wachstums- und Vertriebskennzahlen gemäß den Anforderungen des Managements
  • Teilnahme an regionalen technischen und kommerziellen Veranstaltungen sowie Präsentation und Demonstration von MV-Lösungen
  • Unterstützung, Koordination und Steuerung der Vertriebsaktivitäten in den Zielsegmenten
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Projektteams, SA&A-Teams, Marketing sowie der ESS-Division zur Priorisierung von Zielkunden und Entscheidungsträgern
  • Aufbau und Stärkung der Marke Eaton in den Zielsegmenten sowie Positionierung als Anbieter technisch anspruchsvoller Systeme
  • Sicherstellung der Listung von Eaton-Produkten bei relevanten Approved Vendor Lists (AVL)
  • Vermittlung der Kundenwertargumentation („Value Proposition“) und klare Positionierung gegenüber dem Wettbewerb
  • Auswahl von Key Accounts in Abstimmung mit dem lokalen Management und Entwicklung klarer Account-Strategien sowie Durchdringungspläne
  • Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Planern, Beratern und weiteren Stakeholdern, um Eaton in Großprojekten zu spezifizieren
  • Nachweis von Durchsetzungsstärke bei der Erfüllung von Kundenanforderungen sowie Fähigkeit zur internen und externen Einflussnahme
  • Aufbau starker Partnernetzwerke für laufende Projekte
  • Identifikation von Normen- und Compliance-Anforderungen in Zielmärkten und -segmenten

Qualifikationen:

  • Bachelorabschluss in einem relevanten Bereich (idealerweise Elektrotechnik) oder vergleichbare Erfahrung
  • Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Vertrieb oder Business Development im Bereich Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen

Fähigkeiten:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Utilities- oder Renewables-Segment (alternativ große Industriebranchen)
  • Ausgeprägtes kaufmännisches Verständnis („Commercial Savvy“)
  • Branchen- und Anwendungserfahrung
  • Erfahrung im Key Account Management zwingend erforderlich
  • Teamfähigkeit sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Sehr gute Organisations-, Kommunikations- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten
  • Eigeninitiative und hohe Selbstmanagementkompetenz
  • Präsentations- und Vertriebsmanagementfähigkeiten

Was wir Dir anbieten

  • Herausfordernde Aufgaben in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem Du schnell Verantwortung übernimmst und aktiv mitgestaltest
  • Verantwortungsvolles, abwechslungsreiches und selbstständiges Arbeiten im direkten Kundenkontakt
  • Eine strukturierte und sorgfältige Einarbeitung innerhalb eines eingespielten Teams, in dem persönliches Engagement und gegenseitige Hilfsbereitschaft an erster Stelle stehen
  • Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen mit den beruflichen Möglichkeiten eines Großunternehmens, wie gezielte Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen, umfangreiche Entwicklungsperspektiven und interessante Karrierechancen
  • Ein attraktives, leistungsorientiertes und marktgerechtes Gehalt, einen neutralen Firmenwagen auch zur privaten Nutzung sowie vielzählige weitere vorteilhafte Konditionen im Bereich Compensation und Benefits (Angebote zur Altersvorsorge, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, erhöhter Urlaubsanspruch, Zuschuss zur Home Office Ausstattung, etc.)
  • Werde Teil eines globalen Unternehmens, dessen Mission es ist, die Lebensqualität und die Umwelt durch den Einsatz von nachhaltigen Energiemanagementtechnologien und -dienstleistungen zu verbessern.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiteinteilung
  • Professionelle Unterstützung bei beruflichen und privaten Problemen, ebenso die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und Privatleben durch flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und eine familienbewusste Personalpolitik
  • Starke Prozesse und state-of-the-art Systeme und -Tools
  • Teil eines Unternehmens zu sein, das seit mehr als 100 Jahren besteht, in der Branche bekannt ist und einen großen Einfluss auf die Energieindustrie hat.
  • Arbeit in einem Unternehmen mit Engagement für Inklusion & Diversität und Nachhaltigkeit.
  • Wir handeln ethisch. Wir sind leidenschaftlich, verantwortungsbewusst, effizient und transparent. Wir lernen dazu.

raw.description:
We are seeking a freelance Email Marketing and Graphic Design Specialist to collaborate with us on a monthly, per-project basis. This role involves creating compelling email marketing campaigns and high-quality graphics that align with our brand and marketing objectives. The ideal candidate is a creative professional who thrives in a flexible, project-based work environment and delivers exceptional results within agreed timelines.

This opportunity is ideal for someone looking to earn extra income by taking on additional projects while showcasing their creative and marketing expertise. If this sounds like you, wed love to collaborate!

Scope of Work

Email Marketing

  • Develop 4-6 email campaigns per month, including newsletters, promotional emails, and drip campaigns.
  • Design professional and visually appealing email templates, incorporating effective layouts, images, and call-to-action buttons.
  • Optimize email performance using A/B testing and strategic audience segmentation.
  • Ensure emails adhere to brand guidelines and are compatible across various devices and platforms.

Graphic Design

  • Create custom graphics for email campaigns, social media, and other marketing materials as needed.
  • Design layouts, banners, and infographics to enhance content quality and engagement.
  • Ensure all visual assets align with the overall brand identity and standards.

Project Delivery

  • Manage tasks independently to meet agreed timelines and project milestones.

  • Provide basic performance metrics for email campaigns, such as open rates and click-through rates, upon request.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in email marketing and graphic design (portfolio required).
  • Proficiency with email marketing platforms (e.g., Mailchimp, Klaviyo) and graphic design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva).
  • Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple deadlines independently.
  • Knowledge of best practices in email marketing and responsive design.

Work Arrangement

  • Type: Freelance, project-based.
  • Deliverables: 4-6 email campaigns per month, including accompanying graphics.
  • Rate:$200 per project, to be released upon approval of the completed work.
  • Communication: Minimal communication required, focusing on milestone updates and final project submissions.

raw.title: Product Lead Engineer
raw.excerpt: “Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!
raw.description:
“Be part of a company that is influential and the standard for a rapidly evolving industry!”

WHO ARE WE?

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based out of San Antonio, TX, but are truly a remote and telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Product Lead Engineer serves as the technical authority across multiple Agile scrum teams inside a vertical product. While this role carries no personnel management responsibilities, the Product Lead Engineer has the highest technical voice within the team — setting direction, making implementation calls, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, well-engineered software. Beyond their own contributions, their output raises the technical capability of everyone around them.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

1.Technical Team Leadership

  • Serve as the technical authority within the development teams, making implementation decisions, resolving technical disagreements, and ensuring the team operates to a consistently high engineering standard.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex features across backend, frontend, and mobile platforms — from design through deployment and monitoring — while actively guiding teammates through their portions of the work.
  • Decompose ambiguous requirements into well-scoped tasks for the team, and proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks.
  • Regularly and actively contribute production code — this is a player-coach role. The Product Lead Engineer is expected to be a consistent, high-quality committer and to model the engineering standards to which the rest of the organization is held.

2.Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews that improve quality and accelerate the growth of junior engineers.
  • Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, design discussions, and regular technical guidance.
  • Drive best practices for testing, branching, documentation, and security within the team.

3.Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements, estimate accurately, and deliver reliable features on schedule.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively about technical risks, progress, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

4.Technical Ownership & Cross-Training

  • Take primary ownership of one or more significant product areas — maintaining deep expertise in their architecture, behavior, and failure modes, and serving as the authoritative resource for decisions and issues in those areas.
  • Proactively lead knowledge transfer of your owned areas to teammates, ensuring the team can operate effectively without you and no single engineer becomes a bottleneck.
  • Actively participate in cross-training led by others, developing meaningful familiarity with product areas outside your primary ownership to strengthen overall team resilience.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS

Technical Quality

  • Code, designs, and architectural decisions within the domain consistently meet peer review standards without significant rework.
  • Technical debt and reliability risks in areas of ownership trend downward over time.

Delivery & Reliability

  • Complex features are delivered on schedule with accurate estimation; risks are surfaced early with proposed mitigations.
  • Production incidents in areas of ownership are resolved rapidly with durable root cause fixes.

Organizational Impact

  • Software Engineers who regularly work with this role demonstrably improve in code quality and technical judgment.
  • Technical recommendations are trusted by peers and leads without requiring repeated validation.

Leadership & Communication

  • Ambiguous requirements are clarified and decomposed without waiting for direction.
  • Feedback given in code reviews and design discussions is specific, actionable, and consistently improves the work.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, including production SaaS environments.
  • Deep proficiency in PHP and JavaScript/React, including design patterns, performance, and security best practices.
  • Strong command of relational database design, SQL optimization, and data modeling (MySQL/MariaDB).
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and upskill less experienced engineers.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tooling and workflows.

WHAT SETS YOU APART?

  • 7+ years of professional software development with full-stack ownership in a cloud environment.
  • Experience with cloud architecture on AWS (IaaS/PaaS) including serverless and managed databases.
  • Experience with React Native for cross-platform mobile development.
  • Working knowledge of security benchmarks: OWASP, CIS, SOC2.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience working in regulated environments with compliance requirements (HIPAA, HITECH, PCI DSS, or similar).

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • 10 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Work Anniversary Bonus.
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program.
  • Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement.
  • RealTime matches employee 401K contributions at 100% of the first 3% invested and 50% of the next 2% invested.

All successful candidates must complete and pass reference and background checks.

The desired salary must be indicated for the application to be considered.

The pay rate is commensurate with experience and is determined on an individual basis after an interview has occurred.

Equal Opportunity Employer – RealTime eClinical Solutions strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of its policies and practices, including employment.

Your Right to Work – In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility.

Thank you for your interest in RealTime eClinical Solutions.

raw.excerpt: Overview: We are looking for a Landscape Planting Designer to develop a cohesive planting design and 3D visualization based on an existing landscape plan.
raw.description:
Overview:


We are looking for a Landscape Planting Designer to develop a cohesive planting design and 3D visualization based on an existing landscape plan. The project is already in the construction phase, and all layout and hardscape elements are finalized.

The scope is focused on plant selection, placement, and visualization within defined planting areas only.

Scope of Work:

  • Work from an existing layout (to be provided)
  • Develop a cohesive planting design within designated areas
  • Select appropriate plants suited for the tropical climate (Philippines)
  • Arrange plants with proper layering (trees, shrubs, ground cover)
  • Ensure the design is visually balanced, practical, and buildable
  • No changes to layout, structures, or hardscape elements

Deliverables:

  1. Planting Layout Plan (PDF)
  2. Plant List / Legend (plant names, sizes if applicable, and quantities)
  3. Editable 3D Model (REQUIRED – preferably SketchUp .SKP)
  4. Rendered Images (3–5 views for client presentation)

File Requirements:

  • All files must be fully editable
  • 3D model must be organized (layers/groups for easy modification)
  • We will retain full rights to review, edit, and reuse all submitted files

Revision Policy:

  • Includes up to 2 rounds of revisions
  • Feedback will be provided in a consolidated format

Requirements:

  • Experience in landscape planting / softscape design
  • Ability to create both planting layouts and 3D visualizations
  • Familiarity with tropical plants is preferred
  • Proficiency in SketchUp or similar tools
  • Strong design sense (not just drafting or rendering)

Timeline:

  • Initial submission: 3–5 days after receiving complete materials
  • Revisions: 2–3 days per round

Budget:

  • Fixed rate: ₱15,000 for the entire project

Important Notes:

  • This is not a full landscape design project
  • The layout is already finalized and under construction
  • The task is to develop a thoughtful planting design and visualization within the existing plan
  • Output must be suitable for both client presentation and actual execution

LOCAL PRACTICE OVERVIEW

Radiology Associates of Canton (RAC) was established in 1971 and serves Aultman Hospital main campus, Aultman Orrville Hospital, Aultman Alliance Community Hospital, Southwest General Hospital, and other locations in Cuyahoga, Stark, Tuscarawas, Highland and Wayne Counties. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).

FOR MORE INFORMATION OR TO APPLY:

For inquiries about this position, please contact Mika Nelson at or 217-841-9183.

RADIOLOGY PARTNERS OVERVIEW

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer. RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.

Company Overview:

Milestone is an innovator in post-settlement solutions, providing technology-enabled administration services to law firms managing complex mass tort settlements. Through its proprietary Pathway® platform, Milestone has transformed post-settlement distribution by delivering a more efficient, transparent, and data-driven process for managing claims administration and settlement disbursement.

Position Description:

Support the day-to-day operations of Milestone's Probate Department by partnering with the Managing Attorney to ensure the efficient administration of probate matters, coordinate with external legal partners, and promote operational excellence across the department. Serve as a key legal resource by overseeing local counsel relationships, supporting team coordination, monitoring case progress, and helping drive the successful execution of departmental priorities.

Essential Duties & Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with the Managing Attorney to support the day-to-day operations and overall effectiveness of the Probate Department.
  • Provide operational oversight and guidance to probate team members, supporting efficient workflows, collaboration, and timely case progression.
  • Coordinate team workloads and case assignments to help ensure deadlines, quality standards, and departmental objectives are achieved.
  • Review probate matters for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable laws, court requirements, settlement agreements, and internal policies.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for probate and bankruptcy counsel across multiple jurisdictions, fostering strong working relationships and effective communication.
  • Coordinate the assignment of probate matters to external counsel and monitor case activity to promote timely, high-quality legal services.
  • Monitor the performance and responsiveness of third-party probate counsel, identifying trends, opportunities for improvement, and operational concerns.
  • Collaborate with the Managing Attorney on probate strategies, legal issue resolution, and departmental initiatives.
  • Review project and case status reports to identify workflow bottlenecks, improve operational efficiency, and support continuous process improvement.
  • Prepare operational reports, case updates, and departmental metrics for leadership.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support probate-related initiatives and ensure seamless case administration.
  • Assist with the development, implementation, and refinement of departmental procedures, workflows, and training materials.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound legal judgment when handling sensitive claimant and estate information.
  • Respond promptly to internal and external communications while effectively managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Perform additional legal and operational responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
  • Active license to practice law and member of a state bar in good standing.
  • Two (2) to four (4) years of experience practicing probate law.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, or mentoring legal professionals or support staff.
  • Strong knowledge of probate procedures, estate administration, and court processes across multiple jurisdictions preferred.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and team workloads in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience in Mass Tort Law preferred.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands, talk, and hear. The employee frequently views a computer monitor and frequently uses a computer keyboard. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. The employee is regularly required to be mobile, and the employee occasionally travels both short and long distances via a variety of conveyances.

raw.title: Senior Quantum Algorithm Researcher
raw.excerpt: At NVIDIA, we address some of the world’s most exciting challenges with our unique approach to accelerated computing.
raw.description:
At NVIDIA, we address some of the world’s most exciting challenges with our unique approach to accelerated computing. As a Senior Quantum Algorithm Researcher you will help grow the adoption of our products and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to drive innovation at the intersection of quantum computing applications and AI. Your work will contribute to NVIDIA quantum product in key areas such as AI methods for quantum algorithm discovery, advanced quantum simulations, and digital twins.

NVIDIA’s Quantum group is a small, high-impact team visible both internally within NVIDIA and externally across the global quantum community. We’re looking for passionate quantum algorithm researchers who want to help define the future of the field. Do you have deep technical expertise in quantum algorithms and applications, and a drive to push the boundaries of technology? If yes, we’d love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Establish and lead technical collaborations with supercomputing centers (SCCs) on hybrid quantum-classical application development across multiple industry verticals.

  • Spearhead research pathfinding in AI for quantum algorithms.

  • Guide all aspects of and drive the execution of technical results for projects in collaboration with our strategic partnerships, including SCCs, leading QPU builders, and needle-moving researchers, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and customer success.

  • Contribute to NVIDIA’s revenue stream through strategic technical engagement and the development of innovative solutions that support customer adoption and long-term partnerships.

  • Publish impactful research works and represent NVIDIA at relevant scientific, technical, and industry conferences.

What We Need To See:

  • Ph .D. in Quantum Computing, Physics, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience) with over 5+ years of experience working on Quantum Algorithms and Applications.

  • Deep insider knowledge of, and strong connections within, the Singapore quantum ecosystem.

  • Demonstrated leadership in technical collaborations with industry partners. Excellent programming skills in Python, C++, and a parallel programming model (e.g., CUDA).

  • World-class communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to articulate a value proposition to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A track record of research excellence demonstrated in publications and presentations at leading conferences.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Recognized thought-leadership in the cross section of quantum applied research and high-performance computing.

  • Experience with the NVIDIA Quantum platform (cuQuantum and CUDA-Q)!

title: Senior GPU Raytracing Engineer
description: We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team.

raw.title: Senior GPU Raytracing Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team.
raw.description:
We are seeking a self‑motivated senior engineer for the Aerial Omniverse Digital Twin team. This hire will lead the design and implementation of a real‑time, GPU‑accelerated propagation engine that predicts how radio signals travel through realistic 3‑D environments — producing both per‑link channel characterisations and radio maps at the speed required by production RAN stacks! This position offers the opportunity to work on foundational technology for 5G and 6G network simulation, using NVIDIA's world‑class GPU and ray‑tracing platforms.

What you'll be doing:

As a member of NVIDIA's Aerial team, you will architect and implement a GPU ray‑tracing engine that operates at two time scales. At the planning scale, the engine produces volumetric radio maps — coverage, SINR, and best‑server maps at multiple resolutions, composable across cells, frequencies, and beam configurations — that network operators use to design and optimise deployments. At the real‑time scale, the same engine delivers per‑link multipath channel updates at the millisecond cadence that a production RAN stack requires, using adaptive algorithms that exploit temporal coherence to avoid recomputing what hasn't changed. Laying the foundations for real‑time ray tracing on GPU hardware — algorithms, data structures, and multi‑GPU scaling strategies that make sub‑millisecond propagation updates feasible — is the defining technical challenge of this role.

What we need to see:

  • PhD in computer graphics, high‑performance computing, computational electromagnetics, or a closely related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Hands‑on proficiency with CUDA and at least one GPU ray‑tracing framework (OptiX, Vulkan RT, Embree), with a track record of writing production‑quality GPU code.

  • Proficiency in GPU‑friendly spatial data structures (BVH, space‑filling curves, hash maps) and the ability to reason about memory hierarchy, occupancy, and compute‑vs‑bandwidth trade‑offs at the kernel level.

  • Working knowledge of electromagnetic wave propagation phenomena (reflection, transmission, diffraction, scattering) sufficient to implement and validate a propagation engine.

  • Impactful publications in GPU ray tracing, real‑time rendering, or deterministic propagation modelling.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with real‑time or near‑real‑time ray‑tracing engines shipping in production systems.

  • Prior work on multi‑GPU partitioning for ray‑tracing or large‑scale simulation workloads.

  • Familiarity with 3GPP channel models and wireless network planning tools.

  • Knowledge of geospatial coordinate systems and tiling schemes.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

raw.description:
About us

At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. By embracing an innovative culture of excellence, we pride ourselves on designing, manufacturing and servicing some of the world’s most transformative products. From life-saving medical technology and mission-critical defense solutions to sophisticated industrial automation, we’re proud to partner with our customers to bring their complex ideas to market.


VisitPlexus.comto learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.


Living Our Values

With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. Our values unite and guide us in everything that we do.


Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.


As part of our team, you’ll do impactful work within an inclusive environment where everyone works together to achieve extraordinary outcomes. You’ll be empowered to reach your full potential through managing your own personalised development plan and access to our learning and development programs.


Location:UK - Remote

The Opportunity

As global defence supply chains demand unprecedented resilience, technological sophistication, and security, Plexus stands out as a stable, growing, and deeply trusted partner. We are expanding our footprint, winning record-breaking global programs, and looking for a high-caliber sales leader to spearhead our next phase of growth in the UK Defence sector.

As the Business Development Director for UK Defence, you will hold the keys to a high-growth, highly strategic portfolio. This is not a passive account management role; it is a high-visibility "hunter" position designed for a sophisticated sales executive who can navigate complex MoD supply chains, Tier 1 primes, and aerospace networks.

You will execute our UK Defence growth strategy, translating complex, high-stakes customer requirements into innovative, deliverable engineering and manufacturing solutions. Reporting directly to executive leadership, you will have the full backing of Plexus’ global engineering powerhouse to win major, multi-million-pound programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive the Win:Own the entire end-to-end sales cycle for the UK Defence sector. Identify, qualify, and capture high-value, profitable opportunities from initial market engagement through to contract signature.

  • Leverage the Value Chain:Partner with internal cross-functional engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing teams to translate intricate customer requirements into compelling, innovative proposals utilizing Plexus’ full Product Realization Value Chain.

  • Deploy Strategic Networks:Build, nurture, and leverage deep, multi-level relationships across the UK MoD, Tier 1 Defence Primes, and key industry stakeholders to position Plexus as the partner of choice.

  • Shape Market Strategy:Maintain a sophisticated understanding of the UK Defence landscape, funding cycles, and regulatory shifts to proactively identify market risks, map competitive dynamics, and pivot our capture strategies accordingly.

  • Internal Advocacy:Act as the voice of the UK Defence customer internally, collaborating with account leaders to champion the capabilities and infrastructure required to meet evolving defense demands.

Who You Are (Qualifications)

  • Defence Industry Authority:You possess a Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) alongside a proven, progressive track record of business development or sales leadership specifically within the UK Defence sector.

  • A Proven Deal-Maker:You bring a well-established, active professional network within UK Defence and a demonstrable history of securing significant, multi-million-pound revenue streams.

  • Strategic Challenger:You are an expert in complex, long-cycle enterprise selling methodologies (e.g., Miller Heiman, Shipley, or Challenger Sales) and know how to sell value over price.

  • Executive Presence:You possess exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with an innate ability to build immediate credibility with C-suite executives and military/government stakeholders.

  • Analytical & Autonomous:You can independently navigate complex organizational landscapes with minimal oversight, translating market intelligence into actionable commercial strategies.

Security Clearance Requirement

Due to the critical and sensitive nature of our work within the UK Defence sector, this position is subject to strict security restrictions.

  • National Security Vetting:This role requires validSecurity Clearance (SC). Holding an active SC clearance is highly advantageous; however, candidates willing and eligible to undergo, achieve, and maintain SC clearance prior to commencing employment will be fully considered.

  • Eligibility:To meet the baseline criteria for UK SC clearance, you must generally have been a continuous resident in the UK for the last 5 years.

What We Offer

Plexus offers a dynamic, high-reward environment where top-performing professionals can make a direct, visible impact on global defence readiness. We provide a highly competitive executive compensation package, including an attractive performance-driven incentive structure, comprehensive benefits, and a clear pathway for executive career progression within a globally recognized brand.


Your Rewards and Wellbeing

We believe in rewarding your contribution with a comprehensive package designed to support your life both inside and outside of work.

  • Growth: Bespoke development plans and volunteer time off
  • Health: Private medical insurance, Employee Assistance Program and vision care
  • Wealth: Enhanced pension contributions, life assurance, and group income protection
  • Lifestyle: Electric Vehicle and Cycle to Work schemes, plus 33 days of annual leave

Application Process

At Plexus, we don't look for culture fit, we look for culture add. We value the unique perspectives you bring and review every candidate holistically, balancing professional experience, education and individual journey.


Accessibility and Accommodations

As a Disability Confident employer, we recruit purely on the basis of skills and merit, ensuring an equitable process for everyone. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities or special requirements. If you require support during the application process, please contact us at with your contact information and a description of your needs.


Note: This inbox is dedicated to accommodation requests; please note that application status updates cannot be provided via this address.
